episode.title: QR 찍고 들어온 너
episode.tone: covid-era romantic comedy with emotional undertones
episode.style: clean Korean webtoon style, soft cinematic lighting, expressive facial acting, pastel-romcom mood mixed with realistic covid-era details

style_guide.color_palette: soft pastel pink, cream, mint, muted city grays, warm cafe tones
style_guide.global_negative_prompt: low detail, deformed anatomy, extra fingers, bad hands, blurry face, inconsistent character design, messy background, text artifacts, duplicate characters, incorrect mask placement, low-quality comic layout

character_bible.name: 윤아진
character_bible.visual_core: bright Korean college woman with rabbit-like charm, slim build, clear fair skin, large expressive eyes, straight dark brown hair with soft bangs, neat and tidy appearance
character_bible.wardrobe: light cardigan or clean blouse, casual campus outfit, white or pastel face mask, practical tote or shoulder bag, always carries hand sanitizer and file folder
character_bible.expression_notes: often composed, but blushes easily around Kang Jihwak; eyes become wide and flustered when caught off guard

character_bible.name: 강지확
character_bible.visual_core: tall Korean college man with subtle Middle Eastern vibe and puppy-like warmth, broad shoulders, thick eyebrows, deep-set eyes, sharp nose, defined face line, black slightly wavy hair
character_bible.wardrobe: dark casual jacket or hoodie, black or dark mask, simple campus-casual look
character_bible.expression_notes: first impression looks cool and intense, but when he smiles his eyes soften with mischievous warmth

character_bible.name: 백서우
character_bible.visual_core: pale and refined Korean man with tofu-plus-fox charm, clean features, soft eyes, neat side-parted hair, polished and composed aura
character_bible.wardrobe: crisp shirt, neat outerwear, perfectly worn mask, clean and elegant look
character_bible.expression_notes: usually smiles softly, but his eyes turn cold or shadowed when jealous

character_bible.name: 민서
character_bible.visual_core: cheerful Korean college woman, lively expressions, practical casual outfit, friend-next-door energy
character_bible.wardrobe: cafe part-time casual outfit, ponytail or tied hair
character_bible.expression_notes: used for comedic timing and reaction shots

scenes.scene_summary: 코로나 시대의 공기와 작품의 기본 정서를 보여주는 도입부.

cuts.visual_prompt: Empty Korean downtown street during the COVID era, quiet and slightly melancholic, few pedestrians wearing masks, muted city atmosphere, cinematic vertical webtoon establishing shot.
narration: 그 시절, 사랑은 금지된 건 아니었다.

cuts.visual_prompt: Close-up of COVID-era signs in Korean: mask required, QR check-in required, 2m distancing stickers, realistic public health signage.
Masked pedestrians carefully avoiding one another on a quiet street, subtle tension and caution in body language.
narration: 다만 가까워지는 일이, 조금 어려웠을 뿐.

cuts.visual_prompt: A masked young couple almost holding hands but hesitating, emotional visual metaphor for restricted intimacy during the pandemic.
TV news screen about rising COVID cases and required PCR tests before overseas departure, Korean broadcast style.

dialogue.speaker: 뉴스 앵커
dialogue.text: 해외 출국 전 PCR 검사 결과가 필수로 요구되며…

cuts.visual_prompt: Entrance of a warm Korean cafe during COVID era, sanitizer station and QR guide at the door, Yoon A-jin standing neatly at the entrance preparing the space.
narration: 특히 나처럼, 반드시 아무 일 없어야 하는 사람에게는.

cuts.visual_prompt: Close-up of Yoon A-jin's focused eyes above her mask as she prepares for the day with seriousness.

scenes.scene_summary: 아진의 성격, 유학이라는 목표, 그리고 방역 강박에 가까운 철저함을 보여준다.

cuts.visual_prompt: Yoon A-jin lining up sanitizer bottles, checking a no-contact thermometer, and straightening QR signage with meticulous care.
Minseo watching A-jin in amused disbelief behind the cafe counter while A-jin aligns distancing stickers perfectly.

dialogue.speaker: 민서
dialogue.text: 윤아진, 너 진짜 방역청에서 파견 나온 사람 같아.

cuts.visual_prompt: Close-up of A-jin carefully adjusting a social distancing floor sticker with exaggerated seriousness.
Minseo making a dry, unimpressed face in a comedic reaction panel.

dialogue.speaker: 민서
dialogue.text: 아니, 사람 마음은 원래 삐뚤어져 있어.

cuts.visual_prompt: Inside A-jin's bag: extra masks, hand sanitizer, tissues, small thermometer, and a study abroad file labeled D-14 departure.
A-jin holding her file with 'D-14 departure' visible, taking a determined breath behind her mask.
A customer enters with mask under the nose; A-jin immediately reacts with strict posture while Minseo watches.
A-jin delivering a sharp but controlled line, eyes intense above her mask.
narration: 내 인생은 드디어 출국장 앞까지 와 있었다.

scenes.scene_summary: 지확의 첫 등장과 아진의 첫 흔들림.

cuts.visual_prompt: Close-up of the cafe door bell ringing as the door opens.
Kang Jihwak enters the cafe, tall and striking, dark hair, thick brows, deep eyes above a black mask, cool first impression with subtle playful aura.
A-jin freezes in surprise, eyes widening as she looks at the new customer.
narration: 마스크 위쪽만 봤는데 왜 얼굴 전체가 시끄럽지?

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin regains composure and addresses Jihwak formally at the entrance while he stands relaxed.
Jihwak checking his phone, then giving a sheepish yet confident look.
A-jin quickly slides over a handwritten visitor logbook and pen.
Jihwak glancing down at the pen with playful caution.
A-jin answering with rehearsed confidence, one hand near sanitizer and the other at the logbook.
Jihwak glances at the sanitizer and extends his hand toward A-jin in a way that momentarily feels like hand-holding.
cuts.camera: medium shot with focus on hands

cuts.visual_prompt: Close-up of A-jin squeezing way too much sanitizer into Jihwak's palm, sanitizer overflowing dramatically.
Jihwak staring at his sanitizer-soaked hand while A-jin tries to stay dignified and Minseo laughs in the background.

dialogue.speaker: 강지확
dialogue.text: 이 정도면 손이 아니라 전생까지 소독되겠는데요.

cuts.visual_prompt: Close-up of the handwritten visitor log showing the name '강지확', with A-jin's eyes lingering on it.
A-jin flustered and defensive, Jihwak amused and leaning slightly in with playful eyes.
A-jin points to her name tag while Jihwak reads it, eyes softening slightly.

scenes.scene_summary: 아진이 처음으로 감정적으로 크게 흔들리는 코믹 하이라이트.

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin raises a no-contact thermometer toward Jihwak, but her hand trembles slightly while he stands still.
Thermometer display showing 37.5 in a dramatic close-up.
Jihwak looks mildly surprised while A-jin freezes in embarrassment.
Reveal that A-jin accidentally measured herself; Minseo in the background starting to crack up.
Minseo laughing hard with a hand over her mouth.
A-jin trying to regain professionalism while Jihwak's eyes smile above his mask.
Second thermometer reading, accurately showing 36.4 this time.
A-jin trying to end the interaction while Jihwak sneaks in one more teasing line before entering the cafe.

dialogue.speaker: 윤아진
dialogue.text: 체온은 음성 양성으로 말하는 거 아니거든요.

cuts.visual_prompt: Jihwak walking into the cafe, looking back with a teasing smile in his eyes while A-jin stiffly maintains authority.

dialogue.speaker: 윤아진
dialogue.text: 마스크 제대로 쓰고, 자리 간격 지키고, 불필요한 대화 자제하시면요.

scenes.scene_summary: 지확이 단순한 플러팅 상대가 아니라 다정한 사람이라는 실마리를 준다.

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin steals a glance at Jihwak seated in the cafe while Minseo notices it immediately.
Jihwak sitting quietly by the window, mask still on, calmly looking at his laptop before coffee arrives; more composed than expected.
Comic-style checklist in A-jin's imagination titled '강지확 위험도 체크', with funny bullet points and A-jin's serious face beside it.
narration: ● 웃으면 심장 방역 실패 가능성 있음

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin shocked by her own last thought, scribbling it out mentally in embarrassment.
A small child crying because their mask strap snapped inside the cafe while the mother rummages frantically in her bag.
Jihwak stands first, taking a fresh mask out of his bag and offering it to the mother without touching the child, considerate and calm.
Jihwak kneeling to the child's eye level, speaking gently with playful warmth while the child calms down.
A-jin watching Jihwak with softened eyes, re-evaluating him.
Jihwak catches A-jin looking and makes a tiny circle gesture with his fingers as if asking about his score; A-jin looks away while Minseo smirks beside her.

scenes.scene_summary: 안정적이고 완벽한 대안처럼 보이는 서우의 존재를 심는다.

cuts.visual_prompt: Baek Seowoo enters the cafe, neat, pale, and elegant, with a perfectly worn mask and soft polished aura.
A-jin visibly relaxes and smiles when she sees Seowoo, contrasting her flustered reactions with Jihwak.
Seowoo hands A-jin a neat paper bag containing KF94 masks, sanitizer, tissues, and vitamins.

dialogue.speaker: 백서우
dialogue.text: 출국 전까지 조심해야 하잖아. 필요한 거 넣어뒀어.

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin touched and appreciative, holding the bag close.

dialogue.speaker: 윤아진
dialogue.text: 선배 진짜… 항상 필요한 걸 어떻게 알아요?

dialogue.speaker: 백서우
dialogue.text: 너는 중요한 일 앞두면 이상하게 하나씩 빼먹으니까.

cuts.visual_prompt: Seowoo noticing A-jin's mask strap slightly twisted and gently indicating how to fix it without touching her.
Jihwak glancing toward A-jin and Seowoo from his table, expression casual but observant.
A-jin asks Seowoo about Jihwak while Seowoo's polite face hides a flicker of tension.
Close-up of Seowoo's polite face as his eyes cool slightly for one moment.

scenes.scene_summary: 거리두기 너머로 두 주인공의 감정 거리가 좁혀진다.

cuts.visual_prompt: Minseo points A-jin to the only available seat, which happens to be across from Jihwak with an empty table between them for distancing.

dialogue.speaker: 민서
dialogue.text: 아진아, 너 잠깐 쉬어. 저기 자리 하나 비었어.

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin sits at a table exactly 2 meters away from Jihwak, with a distance sticker clearly visible between them.
A-jin stiffening at the question, trying to stay cool while opening her laptop.
Jihwak lightly leaning back with amused eyes while A-jin looks ready to shut him down.

dialogue.speaker: 윤아진
dialogue.text: 그 얘기 한 번만 더 하면 퇴장입니다.

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin's laptop and documents showing study abroad materials and departure preparations.
Jihwak notices the study abroad documents; the tone shifts from teasing to genuine interest.
A-jin admits how much depends on not getting infected; Jihwak listens more seriously now.

dialogue.speaker: 윤아진
dialogue.text: 그래서 더 조심해야 돼요. 확진되면 출국 일정 다 꼬여서.

cuts.visual_prompt: Close-up of Jihwak giving a sincere, grounded look, no teasing this time.
narration: 가끔 사람은, 마스크를 써도 마음이 보인다.

cuts.visual_prompt: Seowoo watching from afar as A-jin looks at Jihwak with softened attention, his expression still polite but eyes darkening slightly.
Jihwak stands with a cup and tries to step closer, but A-jin raises her hand immediately to stop him; 2m sticker emphasized below.

scenes.scene_summary: 작품의 핵심 밈인 '확진커플'이 처음 탄생하는 장면.

cuts.visual_prompt: Minseo passing by with the visitor log, suddenly realizing the name combination, while A-jin senses trouble.
Graphic insert highlighting the names 강지확 and 윤아진 side by side in a playful comic layout.
Minseo grinning as she delivers the punchline; A-jin flustered instantly, Jihwak interested and amused.
Jihwak smiling with real amusement, eyes folding slightly above the mask.
A-jin denying everything while Jihwak continues to push the joke just enough to feel like flirting.
Minseo collapsing into laughter while A-jin turns bright red.
Jihwak casually delivers a killer line while A-jin freezes completely.
Close-up of Seowoo's hand subtly crushing a paper cup while he watches the scene from afar.
cuts.camera: close-up on hand and partial face

scenes.scene_summary: 지확의 센스가 아진의 마음에 조금 더 깊게 들어온다.

cuts.visual_prompt: A customer coughs loudly in the cafe; nearby patrons visibly tense up and look over.
A-jin approaches carefully, trying to de-escalate with polite professionalism.

dialogue.speaker: 윤아진
dialogue.text: 혹시 몸이 불편하시면 물 드릴까요? 필요하시면 잠시 바깥에서…

cuts.visual_prompt: The coughing customer reacts defensively, annoyed by the implied suspicion.

dialogue.speaker: 기침 손님
dialogue.text: 아니라니까요. 요즘은 기침도 마음대로 못 해?

cuts.visual_prompt: Jihwak steps in naturally without escalating, placing a bottle of water at an appropriate distance from the customer.

dialogue.speaker: 강지확
dialogue.text: 사레면 물 드시면 좀 나을 거예요.

dialogue.speaker: 강지확
dialogue.text: 요즘 다 예민하잖아요. 서로 조심하면 좋죠.

cuts.visual_prompt: The customer awkwardly softens, tension in the cafe dissolving.
Back at his table, Jihwak asks with his eyes for a score update while A-jin fights a smile.
Jihwak looks overly pleased at the score increase.
Seowoo watches A-jin's fresh, embarrassed smile toward Jihwak and realizes it is different from the comfortable smile she gives him.

scenes.scene_summary: 서우가 본격적으로 삼각 구도를 형성하며 긴장을 만든다.

cuts.visual_prompt: Near the back door of the cafe, A-jin carries trash out during closing time, evening light turning cooler.
Seowoo is waiting there quietly; A-jin looks surprised but not alarmed.
Seowoo asks about Jihwak while keeping an outwardly gentle expression.

dialogue.speaker: 백서우
dialogue.text: 처음 본 사람 치고는 많이 웃던데.

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin genuinely surprised by that observation, not fully understanding why it unsettles her.
Seowoo speaking gently but with weighted subtext; A-jin listens attentively.

dialogue.speaker: 백서우
dialogue.text: 출국 전까지 괜히 흔들릴 일 만들지 마.

cuts.visual_prompt: Close-up of Seowoo after a brief pause, voice still soft but eyes slightly shadowed.
After Seowoo leaves, A-jin looks down at her phone as Jihwak's text appears, softening her face slightly.

dialogue.speaker: 강지확
dialogue.text: 그리고 제 방역 점수 5점으로 오른 거 축하합니다.

narration: 나는 강지확이 위험한 사람인지, 내 마음이 위험해진 건지 구분하지 못하게 됐다.

scenes.scene_summary: 달콤한 기류 위로 사건이 떨어지며 2화를 향한 훅을 만든다.

cuts.visual_prompt: Near closing time, warm lights dim in the cafe entrance as Jihwak pauses before leaving and calls out to A-jin.
Jihwak offers a packaged fresh mask to A-jin in a simple but meaningful gesture.
Jihwak explains that he saw her give away her last extra mask earlier; A-jin is touched and caught off guard.

dialogue.speaker: 강지확
dialogue.text: 많은 사람은 아까 자기 마지막 여분까지 남한테 안 주던데.

cuts.visual_prompt: Jihwak pauses and looks at A-jin meaningfully while she clutches the mask package.
Jihwak delivers a soft, teasing line with smiling eyes; A-jin is completely defenseless against it.

dialogue.speaker: 강지확
dialogue.text: 제 이름 너무 오래 보진 마세요.

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin turning red and stiff, clutching the mask package, while Minseo later pops in to tease her expression.
Night outside the cafe, the street quiet again; A-jin steps out after closing, holding her bag and mask gift.
A-jin's phone lights up with an official Korea Disease Control alert message, the mood changing instantly.
Close-up of the alert text saying her movement overlapped with a confirmed case at the cafe and that she should get tested.
narration: 귀하는 금일 14:20~15:10 ○○카페 방문 확진자와 동선이 겹친 것으로 확인되었습니다.

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin's face drains of color, hand trembling, with the file in her bag slightly open revealing D-14 departure.
Jihwak on a nearby street also receiving the same official alert on his phone, his playful expression disappearing.
Split-screen vertical panel showing A-jin and Jihwak on their respective streets texting each other after receiving the alert.
A-jin staring at the phone unable to answer right away while Jihwak waits, concern growing.

dialogue.speaker: 강지확
dialogue.text: 아니, 같이 가면 안 되나. 각자 가요. 대신 연락하면서.

cuts.visual_prompt: Even in the middle of fear, Jihwak sends a line that makes A-jin involuntarily smile through panic.

dialogue.speaker: 강지확
dialogue.text: 오해하지 마세요. 제가 원한 밀접접촉은 이게 아니었어요.

narration: 그날 밤, 나는 확진자 동선에 걸렸고,

cuts.visual_prompt: Final vertical composition: A-jin on one side with her phone, Jihwak on the other side texting back, and Seowoo in the distance watching. Korean romcom cliffhanger composition.

dialogue.speaker: 강지확
dialogue.text: 그럼 내일부터 제가 5점짜리 방역 요원 해드릴게요.
